home.title: Scacelith — photorealistic chess, played in first person
home.description: Take your seat in a sunlit royal hall and play chess in first person against a porcelain robot driven by Stockfish 19, with a coach, online play and FIDE ratings. Free software for Windows.

hero.image_alt: Two porcelain robots play chess at a walnut table in a sunlit marble hall.
hero.lead: Take your seat at a waxed walnut table in a sunlit royal hall. Across the board, a porcelain robot driven by Stockfish waits for your first move.
hero.meta: Free software · Windows 64-bit · Graphics card with OpenGL 4.6
hero.caption: Captured in the game: the title screen

experience.title:
Not a board on a screen.
A seat at the table.
experience.lead: Scacelith brings back what makes a real game: the hall, the silence, the clock, an opponent who looks at you, and the rituals of the tournament.

presence.title: In the first person
presence.text: You see through your robot's eyes. Look around the hall, lean towards the board, look up at your opponent, or glance at the scoresheet beside you.

ritual.title: Tournament rules
ritual.text: A piece you touch must be moved. Your hand presses the clock to complete the move. An illegal move brings the arbiter, and a second one loses the game.

scoresheet.title: Written by hand
scoresheet.text: Both players record every move on their own scoresheet, each in a handwriting of their own, and turn the page every forty moves. You hear the pen on the paper.

opponent.title: A worthy opponent
opponent.text: Stockfish 19 at your level, from Novice (800) to full strength (3500), with a rating computed by the FIDE rules after every game.

engine.title: Built for this game
engine.text: An engine written from scratch: physically based light, marble, waxed wood, porcelain and brass, the sun through the windows, soft shadows and reflections.

languages.title: Ten languages
languages.text: English, French, German, Spanish, Ukrainian, Russian, Arabic, Japanese and Chinese, simplified and traditional. Arabic is laid out right to left.

modes.title:
Every game
has its table.
modes.lead: Everything is played in the same hall, from the title screen. Offline, Stockfish is always ready for a game.

new_game.name: New Game
new_game.text: Face Stockfish at the strength of your choice, with a time control from bullet to classical, or play a friend on the same computer, each from their own robot's eyes.

coach.name: Coach
coach.text: A teacher sits across from you, plays at your level and talks you through the game: threats, good moves, mistakes. From the rules of chess to expert level, with a synthesised voice.

online.name: Play Online
online.text: Real opponents through a Scacelith server: rated games, matchmaking, challenges and private games. Your opponent's robot moves with them, live.

watch.name: Watch a Game
watch.text: Two Stockfish players face each other while you move freely around the hall, invisible, from one viewpoint to another.

saved.name: Saved Games
saved.text: Your games are kept as PGN files. Replay them in the hall, with the real thinking times and clocks, or bring in games from other programs.

gallery.title: Seen from inside the hall
gallery.lead: Every picture is captured in the game, in real time, by its own engine.

online.title:
Real opponents,
the same hall.
online.lead: Sign in to the official server from the game and play people from everywhere, still in the first person.
online.point_rated: Rated games in every official time control, with a FIDE rating for each.
online.point_match: Matchmaking, challenges by name, private games with a code, and direct matches between two computers.
online.point_fair: Fair play: automatic checks, engine analysis of finished games and player reports.
online.point_history: Your game history on this site: download each game as PGN or as an animated GIF.
online.point_open: Anyone can run a community server: the server and its API are free software.

download.title:
Take your seat.
Free, and open source.
download.lead: No installer: download, unzip, and run Scacelith.exe. Every file is built from its tagged source by GitHub Actions, with an attested build provenance.
download.req_gpu_value: A graphics card with OpenGL 4.6 and an up-to-date driver
download.req_included_value: Stockfish 19 and its neural network: play offline right away
download.req_network_value: For online play, GIFs, and the coach's voice (an optional download of about 145 MB)
download.verify_text: Each file's build provenance is attested by GitHub. With the GitHub CLI:

credits.title: Credits and thanks
credits.engine: Stockfish 19, by the Stockfish developers (GNU GPL v3). Its neural network was trained on data provided by the Leela Chess Zero project (Open Database License).
credits.voice: Synthetic speech generated by Supertonic 3 for Coach Mode. Supertonic 3 is a model by Supertone, used under the OpenRAIL-M licence.
credits.fonts: EB Garamond by Georg Duffner, Cinzel by Natanael Gama and Amiri by Khaled Hosny (SIL Open Font License); chess figures from GNU FreeFont.
credits.openings: Opening names from the chess-openings database of lichess.org, dedicated to the public domain (CC0).

footer.about: A photorealistic chess game played in first person, on an in-house OpenGL 4.6 engine. Free software under the GNU GPL v3.
footer.credits: Stockfish is a trademark of its developers. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Windows is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation.
footer.made: This site uses no cookies and no trackers.

account.title: Your account
account.auth_foot: One account on the official server, for the game and this site. Created your account with Google in the game? Use “Forgot password?” to give it a password.

signin.title: Welcome back
signin.remember: Keep me signed in on this device

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

register.title: A free account
register.closed: The server does not accept new accounts at the moment.
register.username_hint: Letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter or a digit.
register.password_hint: At least 10 characters, without your user name or e-mail.
register.pow_note: To keep robots out, your browser solves a small puzzle when you sign up. It takes a few seconds.
register.done_text: We sent a confirmation link to your address. Open it to create your account, then sign in.
register.done_hint: The link is valid for 24 hours. Nothing in your inbox? Check your spam folder, or ask for the e-mail again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.text: Enter the e-mail address of your account. If it has one, we send you a link to choose a new password, valid for one hour.

resend.title: Confirm your e-mail
resend.text: Did not get the confirmation e-mail, or did the link expire? Enter your address to get a new one.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.text: Each sign-in, in the game or on this site, is a device. Sign out the ones you do not recognise.

settings.challenges_text: Other players can challenge you by name from the game.
settings.mfa_text: Turn it on or off, and make new recovery codes, from the account page of the game.
settings.password_text: Your other devices are signed out, and this one stays signed in.
settings.export_text: Everything the server keeps about your account, in one JSON file.
settings.delete_text: This cannot be undone. Your games and ratings stay, under an anonymous name; your e-mail address, password and devices are erased.
settings.delete_confirm: Type your user name to confirm

gif.title: Animated GIF
gif.note: The server draws each GIF. A GIF you already made comes back at once; new ones are limited to a few per minute.
